method: Hand computation from this vector's input.json and conventions.json together with docs/CONVENTIONS.md and the METRIC_DEFINITIONS in src/types.ts. No metric-computing code was written, imported or run, and no expected.json was opened while this file was produced.
rounding: Half-up to four decimal places. Terminating values are left exact — 15.625 is reported as 15.625, not 15.63.

working.step0_payDefinition: BASE is basic and BONUS is complementary_variable; nothing is excluded. Pay level = BASE + BONUS for (a), (c), (f), (g); the BONUS column alone for (b) and (d). payBasis as_paid, so the figures are taken as given.
working.step2_sexSplit: Four women (w01-w04), four men (w05-w08). Every sex value is mapped, so excludedN is 0.
working.step5_metricC: Both sexes have four members, so lower_of_two applies twice. Female ascending 2000, 2400, 3000, 3400 -> middles 2400 and 3000 -> 2400. Male ascending 2200, 2800, 3600, 4200 -> middles 2800 and 3600 -> 2800. (2800-2400)/2800 = 400/2800 = 0.1428571... -> 14.2857.
working.step6_metricD: Female BONUS ascending 200, 300, 400, 500 -> middles 300 and 400 -> 300. Male BONUS ascending 200, 400, 600, 800 -> middles 400 and 600 -> 400. (400-300)/400 = 0.25 -> 25.
working.step7_metricE: All eight BONUS figures are strictly positive, so 4 of 4 women and 4 of 4 men receive a component. Scalar 100.

step8_quartiles.sizes: n = 8, 8/4 = 2 exactly. No remainder, so quartileRemainder is not exercised here — that is what makes this the control vector against v03, v04 and v05.
step8_quartiles.tie: No two workers share a total pay level, so quartileTieRule is not exercised either. The quartile split is forced.

composition.Q1: w01 F, w05 M -> 50 percent female
composition.Q2: w02 F, w06 M -> 50 percent female
composition.Q3: w03 F, w04 F -> 100 percent female
composition.Q4: w07 M, w08 M -> 0 percent female

step8_quartiles.scalarChosen: 50, the female share of the lowest quartile pay band.

working.step9_metricG: Every worker sits in the single category Ops, so the category gap is arithmetically identical to metric (a): 15.625 over a population of 8.
working.step10_suppression: minGroupSize is null: nothing is suppressed and nothing is marked unreliable.
working.step11_art10: Ops at 15.625 is at least five percentage points, so the category carries an Art. 10(1) flag. The flag asserts only the first of the three cumulative conditions.

ambiguities.issue: Scope of metrics (a) and (c): total pay, or the ordinary basic wage or salary alone.
readings: Total pay — Art. 3(1)(a) makes pay inclusive, and METRIC_DEFINITIONS restricts (b) and (d) explicitly while leaving (a) and (c) unrestricted.
Basic only — the payBasis heading says Art. 9(1)(a)-(d) report basic and complementary components SEPARATELY.
ambiguities.why: The frozen type restricts only (b) and (d). Under the other reading metric (a) here would run over BASE alone — female mean 2350, male mean 2700, (2700-2350)/2700 = 12.963 — rather than 15.625, so the fork changes every vector's headline number.

ambiguities.issue: Metric (e) covers the proportion of female AND male workers receiving components, but Metrics.e holds one scalar.
readings: The overall proportion receiving a component.
The percentage-point difference between the female and male proportions.
ambiguities.chosen: The overall proportion receiving a component
ambiguities.why: Under the difference reading every vector including v09 reads zero, which would make v09's stated legitimate zero indistinguishable from the rest. The per-sex split is kept in working.

ambiguities.issue: Metric (f) covers eight numbers — two sexes across four bands — but Metrics.f holds one scalar.
readings: null, since no single scalar can carry the band breakdown.
ambiguities.chosen: The female share of the lowest quartile pay band
ambiguities.why: null is documented as meaning no defensible value exists, and one plainly does. The lowest band is where the remainder and tie rules land in every vector that exercises them.

ambiguities.issue: No convention key governs rounding, and 400/2800 does not terminate.
readings: Four decimal places, leaving terminating values exact.
ambiguities.why: At two places this vector's metric (a) would be reported as 15.63 although 15.625 is exact — precision loss with no rule requiring it. Recorded against this key only because the document has no rounding heading; the real fix is a rounding decision of its own.
